description: Your KPIs as a weather forecast. Everyone reads a weather forecast in half a second, from across the room. KPI Weather turns actual vs target into sunny, partly cloudy, rain or storm for every KPI and adds the trend arrow, free. Add a prior-year (or any) measure and every KPI shows its change against it, free. Premium Outlook forecasts the coming months with the chance of meeting target. No DAX and no emoji: our own weather art, drawn in SVG. Free features: Weather for unlimited KPIs: sunny on target, partly cloudy within tolerance, rain below, storm far below, fog when there is no reading Tolerance bands you set (100 / 95 / 85 % by default) or per-KPI rain and storm thresholds Lower-is-better KPIs (costs, scrap, lead time) per visual or per row; zero-harm targets Five-step trend arrow and sparkline with target line; optional rule that a falling trend lowers the weather One comparison measure, such as prior year: "vs Prior year +4.2%" on every KPI and in the table; the tooltip says better or worse per KPI direction Layouts: one big hero (with wall-screen rotation), a grid of tiles, a forecast strip, and Boardroom mode - the same data as a plain status table Our own weather art in four styles, four themes with their own personality, weather or business words or your own Status is never colour alone: shape and word on every KPI, high contrast, keyboard navigation, reduced…
